newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: GOLF-SMYTH JOINS BID TO TAKE 2005 RYDER CUP TO IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SMYTH JOINS BID TO TAKE 2005 RYDER CUP TO IRELAND.

text.p: Ireland stepped up its bid to stage the 2005 Ryder Cup on Wednesday by forming a committee to oversee preparations.
Former Ryder Cup player Des Smyth is one of eight Irish officials and former players who will spearhead the bid.
Minister for Sport Bernard Allen, who heads the committee, said it would be "a major boost" for Ireland to stage the event.
"Irish golfers have contributed handsomely to the Ryder Cup's development and I feel very strongly that Ireland is, at this stage, well entitled to host the Ryder Cup."
